newsitem.title: USA: Calif. teen arrested in rape, murder of girl, 7.
newsitem.headline: Calif. teen arrested in rape, murder of girl, 7.

text.p: A high school student has been arrested on charges of raping and strangling a 7-year-old girl in a Nevada casino in a crime partly captured on a security videotape, police said on Thursday.

Jeremy Strohmeyer, 18, was arrested at his home in Long Beach late Wednesday on suspicion of killing Sherrice Iverson Sunday after another teenager sought in the killing went to police with his parents, Cpl. Harry Erickson, a Long Beach police spokesman, said.
As a result of what the youth told police, an arrest warrant was issued for Strohmeyer, Erickson said. The informant was not arrested and was not in custody, he added.
Erickson said his department was cooperating with Nevada police and Strohmeyer would be extradited to that state where he was expected to be charged with rape and murder.
The girl was killed early Sunday in a women's restroom near an arcade area of the Primadonna Casino in Primm, Nevada, while her father, LeRoy Iverson, gambled in the casino area.
The casino security office issued a grainy, black-and-white security videotape showing two young men walking near the girl.
The tape also showed one of the men following her into the restroom while the other waited outside. The man came out of the restroom about 25 minutes later, according to a timer on the videotape.
The girl's body was later found in a stall in the restroom.
